fact: On 10 November 2025 the government, through ASIN and IIDiA with Gates Foundation support, officially launched the national JaimeMaLangue project, starting collection of Beninese voices to build a sovereign speech base for training AI models in local languages.
title: Le Bénin lance “JaimeMaLangue” : Une innovation citoyenne et culturelle pour un futur numérique qui parle nos langues
publisher: Gouvernement de la République du Bénin
